reason: The primary CIF parses and symmetry-expands in Fm-3m to a=8.220685 A, Z=4, 40 fully occupied atoms (Ba8Ta4Mn4O24), and primitive-reduces to the intended 10-atom Ba2TaMnO6 formula unit with explicit rock-salt Ta/Mn ordering. All important observed lines from 5-90 degrees are indexed by the F-centered cubic cell, including the ordering-sensitive 111 peak, with no important unexplained reflection and a peak-position RMS of 0.00084 degrees. Although no separate comparable Rwp was supplied, the trace contains instantiated-CIF integrated-intensity refinement over 19 reflection groups (oxygen x about 0.249, equivalent about the ideal setting) and independent whole-profile verification places the submitted x=0.25 model close to the Pawley bound (profile RMSE 0.133 versus 0.122; off-peak noise RMSE 0.102), while freeing x improves RMSE by only about 0.0005. The observed 111 intensity quantitatively rejects a disordered B site, and Ta/Mn exchange is origin-equivalent here; no splitting or extra peaks support symmetry lowering or a superstructure. Periodic shells are chemically valid (Ba-O 2.9065 A x12; Ta-O and Mn-O 2.0552 A x6), there are no overlaps, formal Ba2+/Ta5+/Mn3+/O2- charge is balanced, and bond-valence analysis returns those oxidation states. Thus the submitted explicit ordered realization has convergent positional and intensity support, passes validity and chemistry checks, and no concrete materially different viable branch survives.
